comment: Shipyards: big ships are not bought, they are built. A design claims a slipway; each stage is finished by hauling its material packs to the slip and putting in the labor; the last stage launches the ship and hands you its deed. `reveal` is how far up the hull (metres above the waterline) is drawn once that stage is done. Read by src/content/shipyard.ts.

stages.name: Keel
stages.desc: Lay the keel and the stem.

stages.name: Hull
stages.desc: Plank the hull and fit the iron.

stages.name: Deck
stages.desc: Lay the deck and raise the castle.

stages.name: Rigging
stages.desc: Step the mast and bend on the sail.
